text:
Geelani took over the APHC chairmanship from Maulvi Umar Farooq in 1998, according to his [Wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syed_Ali_Shah_Geelani), which gives his chairmanship as 1998 to 2000. The search did not confirm a formal handover, and the sources conflict on the end date (one says he was replaced by Abdul Ghani Bhat in July 2000). I raised my confidence slightly because the 1998 start date now has a direct Wikipedia source.

CONFIDENCE: 70
